verdict.rationale: Orb documents a Stripe Billing migration path that covers flat-rate, usage, seat and custom logic (orb-docs-13). It supports event backfills to validate historical invoices (orb-docs-14, orb-docs-35) and parallel running alongside Stripe during validation (orb-docs-36), which supports a cutover customers don't notice. Subscriptions can be recreated via the API with aligned billing cycles (orb-docs-8, orb-docs-9). Missing for 10: spreadsheet/CSV bulk import, PCI-compliant card or payment-method data transfer, migration from competitors other than Stripe, and independent or hands-on corroboration of a seamless live cutover.
